productionEstimate: No separate production review is documented for standard OAuth apps. [VERIFY] this against GitHub's own docs before publishing, the fetched page did not explicitly confirm it, this reflects common developer practice rather than a stated policy.

steps.action: Open your GitHub profile picture menu and click Settings, then Developer settings in the left sidebar
Click OAuth apps, then New OAuth App (shown as "Register a new application" the first time)
Fill in application name, homepage URL, and authorization callback URL. GitHub OAuth apps support only one callback URL
Click Register application to get a client ID, then generate a client secret on the app's settings page

escalationPath: GitHub Support (support.github.com) for account-level issues. No partner or business-review process exists for standard OAuth apps.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: Creating an OAuth App
